comparisonPolicy.raw: Complete actual manager observations, returns/errors, exact UTF-8/base64 physical bytes, IDs, timestamps, paths, raw entries, projection, context and convertToLlm are retained. Own undefined fields are separately enumerated.
comparisonPolicy.contract: Only the separately named semantic checkpoint derivation omits real generated identity/time/path values; it compares counts, types, runtime/LLM roles/text, model/thinking, full custom state/hidden payload and declared preservation relations.
omittedFromCrossRunContract: raw error text containing actual IDs
comparisonPolicy.omittedFieldsRetainedAt: cases[].rawObservations and scratch files; no raw observation is normalized.
comparisonPolicy.repeatRule: Two fresh source runs require equal derived semantic/relational contracts and the exact original module closure. Real Date and RNG remain unmodified.
comparisonPolicy.nativeReplay: Native tests may inject the observed actual source-generated entry IDs and UTC milliseconds into native author functions only, to compare actual native append records. The unchanged source receives no ID, RNG or clock shim.
comparisonPolicy.admission: Missing, header, sibling, system, custom-state, edit and compaction targets are rejected by actual appendContextEdit; imported stored replay remains a distinct permissive surface. Null always omits and never restores.
comparisonPolicy.modelInputs: Finite authored executable content; no provider or tool acquisition. Exact null/object/string/array replacements include authored wrapper fields.
comparisonPolicy.scope: Six whole SessionManager context-edit schedules, including actual appendContextEdit and branch/compaction/open. No full original package, phase, provider, recovery or native parity closure claim.
